title: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic)
description: 569 tumors described by 30 numeric measurements. A public teaching dataset where a linear model is known to do well, which makes it a fair test of a claim that Random Forest is clearly better.

suggested_claim.source_note: Illustrative claim written for this example; it is not taken from a published paper.

provenance_note: Exported unmodified from scikit-learn's load_breast_cancer (UCI Machine Learning Repository). Not for clinical use.
